programme.title: Expedition Files
programme.desc: Josh Gates investigates Jim Morrison's death, a "mermaid" in a Japanese temple and an alien abduction claim. From a rock legend's mysterious disappearance, to a bizarrely preserved creature, and a U.S. Airman's extraterrestrial encounter, he seeks the truth behind these unexplained stories.

programme.title: Mystery Of Blind Frog Ranch
programme.desc: There are some places on earth where the land just seems different, and Blind Frog Ranch in eastern Utah is one of those places. Locals say the land is cursed. That it's trying to hold on to something. From Aztec treasure to caverns of gold and silver to lost Mormon mines, legends surround Duane Ollinger's 160-acre ranch in Utah's Uintah Basin. But Duane isn't concerned with the lore. After discovering a system of seven underground caves that run through his property, he is singularly focused on finding what's hidden in them – no matter what the cost.

programme.title: King Tut 100 Year Anniversary Special
programme.desc: Narrated by Josh Gates, the world's leading Egyptologists are on a quest to uncover the secrets of Howard Carter's history-making discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb on the 100th Anniversary of the greatest archaeological find in history.

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs
programme.desc: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: The world's toughest treasure hunters push their bodies and bank accounts to the limit on a quest to strike it rich, hunting the legendary Queen of Gems - Opal. Australia produces more than 90% of the world's opals. Hidden beneath outback desert plains lies a hidden bounty, 30 million years in the making, waiting to be discovered. Opals are one of the most valuable gemstones on the planet – one stone alone can fetch a million dollars – and it's the dream of striking it rich that drives these crews to push their bodies and bank accounts to breaking point.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: A documentary chronicling real life the adventures of one of the most deadliest professions in the world. Follow Alaskan crab fishermen as they face 40-foot waves and intense discomfort with freezing temperatures as they fish in the Bering sea. Sacrificing tooth and nail to catch the seasonal delicacies to later sell and trade on land. Witness the dangers these fisher men face as they battle against the sea, and experience how caution is a crucial part of staying alive.

programme.title: Guardians Of the Glades
programme.desc: Follow snake hunter Dusty "The Wildman" Crum and his team - Brittany, swamp expert Jay, wildlife specialist Gary, survivalist Tom and Florida's number one python-hunting dog Riley, as they hunt down fearsome snake that's terrorizing Everglades - swamps located on the southernmost tip of Florida, called the Burmese python. This notorious predators that escaped captivity after Hurricane Andrew, quickly multiplied after breeding and feeding on the animals in the Glades. Dusty will take matters into his own hands as he tries to stop these deadly creatures from further destroying the ecosystem.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: With a clean bill of health, recent cancer survivor Kristi and her husband Rafael want to be able to live life to the fullest. They've sold their 2500 sq. ft. home and are searching for a tiny home that they can purchase plans for and build themselves in Winston-Salem, NC. But, with a budget of just $45,000 and wildly different design styles, will they find a tiny house that's perfect for this new chapter in their lives?

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: With three young children and one more on the way, parents Rob and Robin are looking for a moveable tiny house in Fullerton, CA. They're about to embark on the adventure of a lifetime and travel the country with their family, but finding a moveable tiny house with space for a large family isn't going to be easy. They're hoping to find a transportable tiny house with separate sleeping spaces for the kids, a full bathroom and the ability to go off-grid, but with a budget of $33,000 will they be able to find the perfect home?

programme.title: In The Eye Of The Storm
programme.desc: As spring tornado season rolls into Father's Day weekend, a rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states. Witnesses scramble for safety as a deadly EF3 cuts power and silences tornado sirens.

programme.title: How To Catch A Dirtbag
programme.desc: Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker. And a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast-food worker.

programme.title: Hunting Atlantis
programme.desc: Stel and Jess investigate a mysterious Greek island where an advanced ancient civilization built a massive marble pyramid. Artifacts there lead them to Turkey where ground penetrating radar reveals an incredible find in the shadow of ancient Troy.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: Having wanted to buy a Ford Cortina for 20 years, Mike finally finds a rust-free Mk2 in Malta. Unfortunately, the rest of the car is a complete shambles so it's down to Elvis and some plucky Maltese mechanics to try, and rescue Mike's Cortina dream.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: In Scotland, the boys fly the flag for the much-maligned Hillman Imp. But having overspent on an Imp at auction, they have a shoestring budget to fix its famous overheating problem. With a journalist lined up to review the finished car, the heat is on.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How It's Made: Dream Cars
programme.desc: Join the legendary 'How It's Made' crew as they immerse themselves in automobile heaven, and discover how incredible machines are designed and created. From a Maserati to the Audi R8, from a Morgan Aero Coupe to a Porsche 911, the team travel around the world to visit the birthplaces of a host of dream cars. Each half hour episode will reveal the cars' inner workings and gorgeous exteriors, which is enhanced with unprecedented access to the factories and test labs that are integral to their conception and creation.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Three previously Chopped Champion chefs return to fight during two regulation rounds with the winner competing in the final round against Chef Maneet Chauhan. The first round is creating appetizers and must include the mandatory ingredients include beef tendon balls, grapes, Italian long hots, and toaster pastry cereal. The second round is the entree round and contestants are mandated to use the basket ingredients including red snapper, zucchini blossoms, antipasto tree, and date syrup. Finally, the remaining contestant will compete with Chef Maneet to develop a dessert that includes creativity, taste, and presentation. The dessert must include the ingredients of hummus ice cream, cherries, turmeric, and chocolate snack cakes. Does the winning chef have what it takes to beat Chef Maneet?

The winner of this battle moves on to the tournament's finale, where one champion will conquer all to seize the opportunity of a lifetime.

In the entree round, the chefs gain some confidence as they work with an Asian street food and a sugary soft drink. programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.desc: Makenna and Kendall highlight hyperlocal Provence ingredients. Meanwhile, students with a wide range of skills -- from a complete novice to a cookbook author -- prove to be a challenge. And Chris identifies a kitchen gadget that dates back to the 1950s.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

programme.title: Castle Impossible
programme.desc: Daphne and Ian take on their first renovation in the castle as they plan to transform the bell tower into a luxury bedroom suite. The tower's in a ruined state and rotten roof beams and a windstorm could turn this project into a catastrophe.

programme.title: Castle Impossible
programme.desc: After completing their new bedroom in the Bell Tower, Daphne and Ian look to create a much needed bathroom. Now, the couple decides to take on a water-damaged room, with no existing plumbing, and turn it into a bathing chamber worthy of royalty.

programme.title: Castle Impossible
programme.desc: Daphne and Ian plan to build on the existing wedding business her grandfather started, and the restoration of the castle depends on their bookings. Now, they hope to gain an edge by creating an impressive office and cozy sitting room to host clients.

programme.title: Home Inspector Joe
programme.desc: A couple is leaving Manhattan to find the perfect forever home for their growing family. With a toddler in tow, they need Joe's help tackling a basement that's been covered up in quick fixes while Noel opens up the flow on the property's first floor.

programme.title: Design Down Under
programme.desc: Georgia and Richie renovate an oceanfront midcentury house for clients seeking a modern makeover. They take on the challenge of bringing different textures to the home to take its aesthetic to the next level.

programme.title: Design Down Under
programme.desc: Husband and wife design build team, Richie Morris and Georgia Ezra, create one-of-a-kind, modern designs and bespoke spaces for their clients in Melbourne, Australia while juggling their thriving businesses and family of four.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: A person suddenly and unexpectedly disappears; no trace, no clues, nothing but the lingering mystery they leave behind. According to the FBI's National Crime Information Center, there are now 110,484 active missing persons cases in the U.S., 53% are juveniles under the age of 18. Most of us have heard of the high-profile cases, such as Natalee Holloway, Stacey Peterson, and Chandra Levy. But have you ever heard of Mae Catherine Rocker, Alexis Peterson or Thomas Jay Kerr? Probably not. They are just a few of the hundreds of thousands of people in this country who one day, simply Disappeared. Most missing person's stories have never been told...until now. Disappeared is an exciting series that investigates the disappearance of these victims, who are here one minute, gone the next. Each episode focuses on one victim's story, as told through the perspectives and actual voices of their closest friends and family and the investigators trying to solve the case. Through interviews with family, friends, police, and searchers, each episode recounts the actions, thoughts, circumstances and motivations that led to each person's disappearance. Experience the victim's final hours until they vanished. Watch interviews with experts, from psychologists to forensic specialists to psychics, who will offer new insights into what may have happened in each case, whether the person was a victim of foul play or a runaway. Disappeared will take you inside the world of the missing, where a person can vanish without a trace, investigators race against the clock to solve a mystery, and the victim's anguished family and friends are left to wonder what in the world could have happened.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Tales of soured romances are explored in this true-crime documentary series, where loved ones turn against each other, leading to fatal consequences. Fraught with jealousy, betrayal, infidelity and anger, each episode focusses on a respective murder, brought to life with dramatic reconstructions and interviews with law enforcement and those with connections to the case. The series examines the incomprehensible outcomes of failing relationships, with emotionally charged partners taking the marital expression, till death do us part, far too literally.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: Perry, New York. 2016. At the cookie factory, friendships rise fast—but so do rivalries. What starts as harmless gossip between co-workers soon turns sour, and when jealousy and ambition boil over, the sweet life at the plant ends in cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: In a small Midwest town, three women bond over their love of Wicca and witchcraft. However, when one of them becomes convinced that a more powerful witch has placed a curse on them, she vows to break the spell - by killing the one who supposedly cast it.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south.".

programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack is accompanied by his mother Sharon Osbourne to the Glen Tavern Inn, a century-old hotel in Santa Paula, California that has a colorful but tragic past. While Sharon enters the investigation unsure about whether or not she believes in ghosts, the more time she and Jack spend at the Inn, the more she is convinced something dark is lurking in the hotel's historic suites. As the investigation's energy grows things take a dramatic turn. Sharon lands in the crosshairs of one of the Inn's most volatile entities, an angry and oppressive male spirit known for overtaking female guests – ending in a still unexplained medical mystery.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack and his good friend Jenny McCarthy head to the Tinker Swiss Cottage in Rockford, Illinois. Recent construction at the museum has upset the ghosts of the Tinker family, leading to aggressive activity. Can Jack, and Jenny soothe these restless souls?

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: Highway To Hell
programme.desc: They say most homicide victims know their killer. But on the open road, your killer might just be someone you've yet to meet. America's highways are its arteries all 160,000 miles of them. But take a look around. How well do you really know the person next to you? How about that truck out front? And is the driver of that car behind just hunting for his next victim? In this series, we explore the deadliest tales of homicide on America's highways - where innocent journeys become deadly trips. Not everyone reaches their destination on the Highway To Hell.

programme.title: Murder Decoded
programme.desc: In the wake of every murder, clues appear. Some are easy to spot, and some are well-hidden. In each episode of Murder Decoded, we tell the forensics-driven stories of committed investigators finding the tiniest trace evidence, using cutting-edge science to understand its relevance, and deciphering which clues mean nothing and which ones will put a killer behind bars all to bring justice to victims' loved ones.

programme.title: American Detective with Lt. Joe Kenda
programme.desc: In American Detective, Kenda trades in his own case files to bring viewers astounding investigations from across the country, with each episode featuring a different homicide detective whose tireless efforts helped put a killer behind bars and bring justice for the victim.

programme.title: Truth About Murder With Sunny Hostin
programme.desc: Host, and former federal prosecutor, Sunny Hostin (from The View) takes us on an investigative journey to uncover the true stories of crime victims and their loved ones. Unlike most crime shows which focus on the motives or backstory of the killers, this show exposes the real, deadly impact on those who suffer at the hands of the perpetrator. The stories of everyday people who get caught up in these heinous crimes often go unheard and it is equally important that these individuals get to tell their stories as it is for us to hear them. Sunny also interviews the detectives, prosecutors, coroners, and others involved to piece together the truth of each case. With an intention to be socially inclusive, the show highlights stories concerning people of color, women and the LGBTQ community.

programme.title: The Real Story with Maria Elena Salinas
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Maria Elena Salinas uses her years of experience to unearth new evidence in criminal cases that have made national headlines. Dubbed the "Voice of Hispanic America" by The New York Times, Maria has travelled the world, reporting on war crimes and interviewing heads of state, dictators, US Presidents and many notable politicians. This series sees Maria seeking truths about crimes committed on US soil, finding the evidence to overturn wrongful convictions, uncovering the clues to prosecute murderers and helping families find closure.

programme.title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
programme.desc: When three synagogues simultaneously go up in flames, federal agents work around the clock to solve the arsons. They get an unexpected break when a double murder 150 miles away reveals new evidence - and a sinister plot of bigotry, fire and fury.

programme.title: Breaking Homicide
programme.desc: The most tragic crimes are the ones that never reached a conclusion, lives have been lost and no one ever held accountable as the case eventually goes cold. What happens when years pass by with no justice? Police Detective Derrick Levasseur and Forensic Psychologist Kris Mohandiewill are on a mission to reopen cases and find answers for the victims and loved ones who need to finally feel peace. They'll be looking into cases such as Michelle O'Keefe and Devan Schmidt murders, re-examining old clues and sourcing new ones, will they be able to find details that have previously been missed?

programme.title: I Almost Got Away With It
programme.desc: For these perpetrators, their stories may be different, but their motives are always the same: to stay out of prison. The people profiled in this series evaded justice for years, sometimes decades, by using their families, fake identification and even violence to avoid capture. Learn what pushed these individuals to their crimes, how they stayed one step ahead of the police and managed to evade the law -- at least for a while.

Various twists and turns can make you question reality, and the final outcome can surprise everyone involved. How well do you know the people next door?

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: When Mike was born he was giving up for adoption. But at the age of 7, he would be given a chance to have a family of his own. His adoptive mother introduced him to the man she was planning to marry. Mike was ecstatic at the idea of having a father figure in his life but got a little nervous when he learned that Kevin would be coming home from prison. His mother and grandfather both assured him that Kevin was a good man who deserved a second chance. Kevin and Mike instantly bonded. He taught Mike how to hunt, fish, and ride a bike. But there was a side to Kevin that Mike didn't like, a sadistic side. Occasionally, Mike would witness his father acting out of line, but when he would try to tell other adults no one would believe him. Everyone would tell Mike that he was only exaggerating his stories. But Mike couldn't shake the feeling that he knew his father was a dangerous man who was capable of getting away with murder.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: Each hour-long episode of this chilling psychological drama tells the harrowing, firsthand stories of living with a person who became a killer. Viewers will be put in the shoes of the loved one, who lived through this incredible experience —from first noticing that something is amiss, to interpreting all of the puzzling signs and clues, to eventually coming face-to-face with the horrible truth: that the person they loved, the person they trusted, has a very dark side.

programme.title: Toxic
programme.desc: When a teenage girl in a tightly controlled religious community falls prey to her charismatic pastor, she's told it is love. Years later, she realises it is abuse and takes on those in the church who would rather destroy her than face the truth.

programme.title: The Baby Killer Conspiracy
programme.desc: Kathy Folbigg claims she is innocent of killing her four children, in a case reminiscent of Sally Clark, whose first son died at 11 weeks, and second at just eight weeks. Convicted of killing her own children, a judge sentenced Clark to life imprisonment.

programme.title: The Baby Killer Conspiracy
programme.desc: While Sally Clark sits in prison for life, journalist John Sweeny and attorney Marylin Stowe look at her case and make their own startling discoveries separately. In Australia, Kathleen Folbigg is convicted of a similar crime.

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: When 21-year-old Christina Whittaker disappeared in the small town of Hannibal, MO, a frantic search immediately ensued. Eight months later, filmmaker Christina Fontana met Whittaker's mother when filming a documentary about the families of missing persons. Little did Fontana know, this one case would lead her down a dark path full of conspiracies, betrayals, suicide and murder. Using more than 400 hours of footage from field investigations and video diaries filmed over 11 years, this documentary follows not only a complex search for a missing person, but the journey of a filmmaker who becomes dangerously ensnared by the story she's documenting.

programme.title: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: As opposed to its sister series ''See No Evil,'' which details unlawful activity rooted out with the aid of surveillance cameras, ''Hear No Evil'' uses authentic audio recorded at crime scenes to build each episode's narrative. The recordings, captured by victims' families, investigators and the killers themselves, reconstruct the murderous acts with the aid of first-person testimony, stylized re-enactments and video archive. The result is a series that ultimately lets viewers' imaginations and instinctive fears of the unknown come to the fore.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: A ranch hand, Czech immigrant Jerry Palensky, disappeared in December 2003 and was found dead in January 2004 in the Jordan River near Salt Lake City, Utah. Homicide investigators across two states worked together to catch the killer. The process of searching for the perpetrator uncovered a trail of fraud, deception and adultery, shocking the small town of Elko, Nevada. In the end, Linda Fields and her husband John Vernon Fields were convicted of the murder. The motive was a $300,000 life-insurance policy on Palensky that Linda Fields had purchased and named herself as beneficiary. In 2007, both John Fields and Linda Fields were sentenced to life in prison with no possibility of parole.

programme.title: Calls From the Inside
programme.desc: March 16, 2020, Chatworth, Georgia: The day after his homicide, fishermen find a 27-year-old man, Kenneth Eugene Bunn, shot to death on a river embankment near the Conasauga River bridge on Carlton Petty Road in Murray County, Georgia. A key suspect in the murder investigation, Nadya Swartz, leaves homicide investigators searching for answers and evidence to piece the timeline of events together. However, jailhouse calls which are incriminating eventually reveal the truth of a twisted love triangle that ended in a brutal murder. In the end, in March 2021, both Nadya Catherine Swartz of Crandall, Georgia (the mastermind) and Justin Payton Hooker of Dalton Georgia (the gunman), both age 21, take plea deals. They are both convicted and sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole after 30 years in confinement for the murder of Kenny Bunn.

programme.title: Killer Confessions: Case Files Of A Texas Ranger
programme.desc: When 28-year-old mother Samantha McNorton vanishes without a trace in Wise County, Texas, police hit a dead end until Ranger Jim Holland steps in and launches a 24-hour whirlwind investigation, determined to uncover the truth.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: Youngstown, Ohio, 2017; Shannon Graves, age 28, went missing under mysterious circumstances. Months later, her partially dissected remains were discovered stuffed into a chest freezer in the basement of a rental home. Who put her there, and why did they store the freezer in someone else's basement? Why was she murdered so cruelly and discarded so heinously? In the end, the three culprits responsible for her disappearance and murder were Shannon's former boyfriend, Arturo Novoa, Arturo's current girlfriend, Katrina Layton, and Arturo's friend, Andrew Herrmann. Novoa, Layton and Herrmann were all arrested and convicted of various crimes regarding the death of Shannon Graves. They were all sentenced to varying amounts of time in prison.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: If you looked into the eyes of a killer, would you know? In American Monster, you find out. For the first time, viewers get closer than ever to some of America's most shocking and surprising crimes. Filled with never-before-seen footage of these devils in disguise, from home movie shots of them playing with their kids to musical performances at high school, from the church cook-out to the wedding video, American Monster interweaves twisting-turning stories of astonishing crimes, with 'behind-the-scenes' footage of killers at their seemingly most innocent.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Watching too many ninja movies has brainwashed Leonard the koala. During the day, as he sleeps, he terrorizes everyone by sleepfighting (as opposed to sleepwalking). He makes the Rat King very angry by beating and humiliating him, and the oversized rodent is out for revenge. The penguins counter-program Leonard with a Lunacorn love movie marathon - is it enough to conquer all? // Private is left to babysit four adorable ducklings as the rest of the gang tries to crash a monster truck rally (unsuccessfully). The ducklings are a rowdy bunch and throw a party, inadvertently attracting party-crashing rats and wasps who attack the party food. Private and the ducklings become trapped in the lair with the food, and as the rats and wasps try to break in, Private must think fast - how can he combat both gangs at once?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins notice it's been quiet at night. Too quiet, something's amiss. The rest of the zoo animals have been sneaking out at night to spend time partying in the park! The plan to sneak out then return by morning to avoid getting caught by Alice is put in jeopardy when they run into the classic New York problem - a traffic jam in the tunnel. How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: Sonic Prime

The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The zoosters think King Julien has caused sweet old lady Gladys to slip and hurt herself, thus cutting off the special treats she brings for them. The rush to judgment condemns the protesting lemur to a mighty swat from the Rump Whomper. As the clock winds down to his unspeakable punishment only one abstains - Skipper's gut inexplicably insists that King Julien is innocent. You should know better than to go against your gut. // Kowalski's dream of attending the giant invention expo INVEXPO have to be put on hold when he's laid up with broken legs. Skipper and the rest of the gang go in his place with the promise to bring him a full report. The injured bird goes stir crazy locked away in the hospital, however, and hallucinates that a dangerous Space Squid is invading! Could this be more than the fevered imaginings of the caged bird?

programme.title: Pinky Malinky
programme.desc: Pinky Malinky, a 12-year-old Middle School student, just so happens to be an anthropomorphic hot dog, who endeavors to climb up the social ladder with his two human friends, Babs Buttman and JJ Jameson.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Welcome to the Patrick Star Show hosted by Patrick himself and revolving around his extraordinary family and his own bizzare fantasies. Get to know his family, his Dad Cecil Star, his Mom Bunny Star, his sister Squidina Star, and GrandPat Star, and find out where his charm and eccentricity come from.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance: The Other Way

programme.title: 90 Day Diaries
programme.desc: An intimate look into the lives of our couples, told from their perspective. Without producers or crew, the cast members film themselves in their day-to-day lives as they continue to navigate the COVID-19 pandemic and all of the new challenges it brings to their relationships.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown?

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Virgins
programme.desc: After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: This programme aims to explore the complicated issues that can happen when teenage pregnancy suddenly happens. Focusing on three girls, the camera captures each trimester and the first few weeks of parenthood. Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: One Day In My Body
programme.desc: An allergic reaction left Kirtus with vitiligo, alopecia, and bone loss. An upcoming surgery could change his life. Portia's rare skin condition may exist in fewer than 25 people worldwide. Dani lost all four limbs, and now she fights to walk unassisted.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France
programme.desc: Professional matchmaker Mandy needs Tan's help to create a traditional Nigerian dress for her glamorous Cyprus wedding. Meanwhile Chelsea needs something glam for her wedding to a footballer-turned-reality-star, Luke.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress With Tan France
programme.desc: Niquita's lifelong dream of saying yes to a gothic, black princess dress is her family's worst nightmare, while divorce lawyer Steph wants some high-fashion to wow her chemistry camp childhood sweetheart.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Poland
programme.desc: Stefano and the consultants welcome Polish pop star Doda to the salon.

programme.desc: In order to reduce stress for plus-sized brides-to-be, best friends and fashion entrepreneurs Alison Law and Jo Cooke start Curves and Couture, a wedding boutique in Essex, London. The shop was inspired by their own miserable experience while shopping for wedding dresses. This is the case when size does not matter. The focus of the reality TV series Curvy Brides' Boutique is on finding the Dress for every single curvy bride and make her wedding day full of wonderful memories. The show follows the bride from the moment she chooses her dress, to her fitting and on her wedding day.

programme.title: High Infidelity
programme.desc: Ivana and Carlo are a married couple, but they're facing a crisis: she's stressed by a pregnancy that seems impossible, and he's happy loving Erika, a young girl he met when he was looking for a new office.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Mummies Unwrapped
programme.desc: Emmy Award-winning director and acclaimed Egyptologist Ramy Romany will journey across the globe to investigate secrets and myths of the most fascinating burial sites, mass graves and ancient tombs on Earth in a Discovery Channel series. Mummies Unwrapped will feature Romany as he travels to ancient Egyptian tombs and Mayan mass graves to untangle the legends, myths, curses and cover-ups of our collective ancient past. The series will also utilize cutting-edge technologies to introduce new theories about how ancient civilizations once lived and died while looking to unravel the origin of each mummy, the life that once was and determine what, if any, mystical forces or supernatural phenomena were involved. Mummies Unwrapped premieres April 10 at 10 p.m. ET/PT on Discovery Channel.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods with Andrew Zimmern
programme.desc: Unmasking an aspect of dining out that will make you think twice before ordering off the menu, and utilizing his knowledge of all things edible, Andrew Zimmern is on a quest to find the world's most bizarre foods. Andrew knows that one man's poison is another's delicacy but he isn't afraid to poke a little fun at the local fare or himself. Our energetic food-a-holic infiltrates markets and restaurants taking viewers behind the scenes to savor the local cuisine - even if that means chewing on eggs with legs, gulping down a beating frog heart or polishing off a lamb's eyeball. Andrew is game for anything and knows the most interesting food is found closest to the source. So whether he's chasing down large water rodents in the Louisiana bayou, fishing for piranha in the Amazon or flushing out cave bats in Malaysia, you can be sure the guy with the iron stomach will dish up the unimaginable.

programme.title: Building Off The Grid: Mountain Man Cave
programme.desc: For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

programme.title: The Alaska Triangle
programme.desc: Experts and eyewitnesses attempt to unlock the mystery of the Alaska Triangle, a remote area infamous for alien abductions, Bigfoot sightings, paranormal phenomena and vanishing airplanes. Throughout the series, we meet a woman whose idyllic Alaskan dream soon descends into a paranormal nightmare, as she starts to suffer attacks by an unseen force. Recent sightings may prove that a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants is true. The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.

programme.title: Mysteries At The Museum
programme.desc: Documentary series in which host Don Wildman, history enthusiast and adventurer, focuses on interesting and unusual artifacts held in museums, historical institutions, and unexplored archives around the world. Don discovers extraordinary, obscure relics and artifacts, shares their incredible stories, that have either been forgotten or are lesser known, and reveals their secrets, taking the viewers on a spectacular tour through history. We also get to find out why and how some of these unusual objects ended up in the museums.

programme.title: Tierarzt Dr. Jeff
programme.desc: Die Mitarbeiter der "Planned Pethood Plus Klinik" sind schockiert. Hündin Juicy Fruit hätte eigentlich vor fast 2 Monaten zur Behandlung ihres gebrochenen Hinterbeins ins Tierkrankenhaus gebracht werden sollen. Jetzt hat sich die Wunde in der Zwischenzeit schlimm entzündet und es ist unklar, ob das Bein noch zu retten ist! Später rückt Dr. Jeff zu einem riskanten Einsatz mit einem Löwenrudel aus. Auch in dieser Folge: Hündin Lola hat Nierensteine und Kater Bobo ist in einen heftigen Revierkampf geraten. Jetzt muss seine klaffende Wunde am Hals versorgt werden.

programme.title: Die Garten-Retter
programme.desc: Marlon und Vicky aus Seattle haben zwei kleine Kinder und einen familienunfreundlichen Garten. Das Geländer ist wackelig, die Terrassenplatten bröckelig, Sperrmüll steht im Weg und überall wächst Unkraut. Höchste Zeit, den Garten in ein Paradies für die junge Familie zu verwandeln! Auf der Agenda steht eine große Terrasse mit Platz für viele Gäste, eine Loggia mit großem Fernseher, um draußen Basketball und Football gucken zu können und eine eigene Zapfanlage für Marlon und seine Freunde. Außerdem bekommen die beiden einen Brunnen und eine farbenfrohe Bepflanzung. Der Garten ist kaum wieder zu erkennen.

programme.title: Die Garten-Retter
programme.desc: Chris Lambton trifft im Baumarkt auf die Heimwerker John und Kyle, die erst vor kurzem ihr erstes eigenes Haus bezogen haben. Das Problem: Eine viel zu kleine und rosafarbene Terrasse. Nach so einem Fall hat unser Host gesucht! Mit seinem Team verwandelt er den Hinterhof in einen zeitgemäßen Garten mit bunten Blumen, einer schattigen Laube und einem großzügigen Essbereich.

programme.title: Die Garten-Retter
programme.desc: Der Heimwerker-Lottogewinn wartet auf Ty, Jill und seine Tochter, die Chris Lambton im Baumarkt aufspürt. Sie haben eine Hühner-Farm im Hinterhof, aber keinen Platz für Gäste. Der Lifestyle-Experte überrascht die Beschenkten nach nur zwei Tagen mit einem komplett neuen Garten – mit Hühnerstall, großem Esstisch, Hochbeeten und Wasserrad.

programme.title: Die Garten-Retter
programme.desc: Die Terrasse von TJ und Julie ist zu klein und der Schuppen sieht aus wie eine Müllhalde – ganz zu schweigen von der nicht vorhandenen Landschaftsgestaltung. Chris Lambtons Kreativität ist gefragt! Mit seinem Team bringt er neues Leben in den Garten, baut eine Steinterrasse mit einem Esstisch, einer Grillinsel und einem Wasserspiel. Neue Pflanzen geben dem Garten seinen letzten Schliff.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade: Geheimnisse der Tiefe
programme.desc: Die Erzählung von Noahs Arche gilt für viele Menschen als eines der bedeutendsten Wunder der Bibel. Aber entspricht die Überlieferung vom Bau des rettenden Holzschiffs wirklich der Realität? Dr. Beverly Goodman, Geowissenschaftlerin und Meeresarchäologin an der Universität von Haifa, versucht das Jahrtausende alte Rätsel anhand von neuen Erkenntnissen zu lösen. Gemeinsam mit weiteren Forscherkollegen untersucht sie, welche Hinweise es auf die biblische Sintflut gibt und ob antike Schiffbautechniken tatsächlich ausgereicht haben könnten, um ein derart gigantisches Konstruktionsprojekt umzusetzen.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade: Geheimnisse der Tiefe
programme.desc: Kompassnadeln, die verrückt spielen, Elektronik, die ausfällt, mysteriöse Nebelschwaden und scheinbar brodelndes Wasser: Was Seeleute aus dem Bermudadreieck im Atlantik berichten, bereitet der Forschung Kopfzerbrechen. Dr. Dijanna Figueroa, Professor Will Zimmerman und Dr. Dawn Wright bringen Licht ins Dunkel der unglaublichen Phänomene. Auch in dieser Folge: Norwegische Wissenschaftler haben riesige Krater am Grund der Barentssee entdeckt. Könnten diese bislang kaum erforschten Strukturen helfen, die rätselhaften Ereignisse am Bermudadreieck zu erklären.

programme.title: Der Katzenflüsterer
programme.desc: Katzentrainer Jackson Galaxy kennt fast jedes Samtpfoten-Problem und hilft, wenn Tierhalter an ihre Grenzen stoßen. Heute ist er bei Gena und ihrer Tochter Alex, die große Schwierigkeiten mit Katze Meeko haben. Sobald Gena in der Nähe ist, spielt der Kater verrückt, kratzt, beißt und schlägt nach ihr. Außerdem pinkelt er die ganze Wohnung voll, so dass er nun immer in ein Zimmer gesperrt wird. Bei Alex ist der Stubentiger lammfromm. Doch das nützt wenig, denn wenn sie demnächst aufs College geht, will Gena den Satansbraten weggeben. Jackson tut alles dafür, um Meeko sein Heim zu bewahren.

programme.title: Der Katzenflüsterer
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy ist nachts Musiker und tagsüber Katzentrainer. In seiner Laufbahn hat er mit Tausenden von Katzen gearbeitet, ihr Verhalten beobachtet und sie wie auch ihre Besitzer umerzogen. In dieser Episode fährt Jackson zu John und Samantha, die von ihrem Kater Puma langsam in den Wahnsinn getrieben werden: Der zehnjährige Stubentiger geht nicht aufs Katzenklo, sondern pinkelt das ganze Haus voll. Klamotten, Schuhe, Möbel – nichts ist vor Puma sicher. Inzwischen hat er die meisten von Johns teuren Anzügen ruiniert und ist schuld daran, dass sein Herrchen in einem wichtigen Meeting streng nach Urin roch.

programme.title: Der Katzenflüsterer
programme.desc: Katzen haben neun Leben, aber ihre Besitzer nur eins. Aus diesem Grund fährt Tierpsychologe Jackson Galaxy zu Chase und Maya, deren Katzen Daisy und Dexter im Dauerclinch liegen und die Wohnung vollpinkeln. Die beiden Stubentiger veranstalten das totale Chaos, so dass bei der Familie dauernd die Hölle los ist. Da auch ihre zweijährige Tochter Chloe regelmäßig zwischen die Fronten gerät, von den pelzigen Monstern umgerannt und gekratzt wird, platzt Vater Chase langsam der Kragen. Er mag keine Haustiere und würde die beiden lieber heute als morgen loswerden. Doch Ehefrau Maya hofft auf die Unterstützung von Katzenflüsterer Jackson.

programme.title: Die Abalonen-Taucher
programme.desc: Der Angriff dauerte nur 15 Sekunden: Greg Pickering wurde von einem Weißen Hai in den Kopf und die Brust gebissen, doch er hat die Attacke zum Glück überlebt. Der Zwischenfall lässt die Tauchergemeinde an der Südküste Australiens erschaudern, trotzdem geht die Jagd nach den Meeresschnecken weiter. Nur vier Tage später stechen die Crews wieder in See. Abalonen-Experte Jay Haagmans versucht sich unter Wasser mit einem auffälligen Taucheranzug zu schützen. Denn in der Natur sind markante Streifen oft eine Warnung an Raubtiere: Achtung, dieses Futter ist giftig.

programme.title: Die Abalonen-Taucher
programme.desc: An guten Tagen holt keiner so viele Meeresschnecken aus dem Meer wie Dominic Henderson. Aber im letzten Jahr hatte der Abalonen-Taucher Probleme mit den Ohren und bekam unter Wasser Schwindelanfälle. Mit solchen Symptomen ist nicht zu scherzen, trotzdem geht der "Dominator" nach einer viermonatigen Pause mit seinem Skipper wieder auf Beutefang. Die seichte Bucht vor der australischen Küste, in der das Duo sein Glück versucht, wirkt auf den ersten Blick sicher. Doch ganz in der Nähe lebt eine Robbenkolonie – die bevorzugte Beute der Weißen Haie.

programme.title: Die Abalonen-Taucher
programme.desc: Port Lincoln ist der Stützpunkt der größten Berufsfischerflotte Australiens und die "Seafood-Hauptstadt" des Kontinents. Meeresschnecken spielen hier eine bedeutende wirtschaftliche Rolle, doch die Saison geht dem Ende zu. Den Crews bleiben bei zunehmend schlechtem Wetter nur noch 60 Tage, um ihre Quoten auszuschöpfen. Deshalb stehen Skipper "Skin" und sein Taucher Jay Haagmans vor der Küste gehörig unter Druck. Das Duo macht dort Jagd auf Roe-Abalonen. Diese Exemplare sind bei den Händlern besonders begehrt.

programme.title: Pitbulls auf Bewährung
programme.desc: Um für die bevorstehende Hurrikan-Saison gewappnet zu sein, haben Tia Torres und ihr Team umfassende Bauarbeiten geplant. Damit die Hunde auch bei Hochwasser trockene Pfoten behalten, sollen die Boxen weiter nach oben verlegt werden. Über eine Art Steg mit Geländer können Mitarbeiter:innen die Tiere dann ebenfalls trockenen Fußes erreichen, falls die Flut wieder zuschlägt. Trotz Umbauprojekten und Covid-Pandemie geht die Vermittlungsarbeit weiter. Heute ist eine 4-köpfige Familie aus Texas zu Besuch, die einen zweiten Pitbull-Welpen adoptieren möchte.

programme.title: Die Wildlife-Cops
programme.desc: Sergeant Brian Fulton und seine Kollegen erwischen bei einer Routinekontrolle am Columbia River einen Hobby-Fischer ohne gültigen Angelschein. Doch wie sich schnell herausstellt, ist dies nicht das einzige Vergehen des Umweltsünders. Denn offenbar liegen gegen den Mann zwei Haftbefehle wegen Drogenbesitz vor. Deshalb nehmen die "Wildlife-Cops" den Verdächtigen umgehend fest. In South Bend wurde unterdessen ein Bär von einem Auto angefahren.

programme.title: Die Wildlife-Cops
programme.desc: Im Nordwesten des Staates Washington, an der Grenze zwischen den USA und Kanada, liegen die San Juan Islands. Officer Zack Gaston und sein Partner Josh Koontz schützen dort in den Küstengewässern bedrohte Orcas. Bei ihren Patrouillen achten die Gesetzeshüter darauf, dass Hobby-Angler und Fischerboote – wie vorgeschrieben – mindestens 200 Meter Abstand zu den Tieren halten. Denn wenn die Wale gestresst sind, hören sie auf zu fressen und bekommen keinen Nachwuchs.

programme.title: Police Dogs
programme.desc: Polizeihunde in Ausbildung: Die Vierbeiner lernen, was sie bei einer Lawine zu tun haben. Außerdem: Am Tatort einer Vergewaltigung gehen die Ermittler auf Spurensuche und Einbrüche halten Stavangers Polizei weiter auf Trab.

programme.title: Police Dogs
programme.desc: Elvis nutzt seinen Charme als der Alarm bei einer prominenten Person losgeht. Währenddessen schwebt Polizeihund Sidney in Lebensgefahr und Stian muss eine schwierige Entscheidung treffen.
